purpose: Calibration reference for position-dependent boundary violation penalties
issues: Scanner trendline selection is structurally inferior to manual geometry
A significant lower-boundary violation occurs around the middle of the structure
The violation occurs too early to be treated as a normal near-apex false breakout
Price subsequently returns inside the candidate structure
desired_behavior: Penalize significant boundary violations occurring in the early or middle part of a wedge
Make boundary violation penalty dependent on its position within the structure
Allow smaller penalties for false breakout and re-entry behavior close to the apex
Do not give a structurally damaged wedge the same quality as a clean wedge
notes: Manual geometry is better than scanner geometry but is not an ideal positive reference. The mid-structure downside violation materially reduces wedge quality. A similar event near the apex could be acceptable as a false-breakout/re-entry scenario.
